title: Contact L+H MarketingServices GmbH
content: Whether you already have a specific project in mind or just have a question: get in touch with us – we're happy to support you with our marketing services.
response_time: We usually respond within 1–2 business days

contact_details.title: Contact details
contact_details.contact_info: You can also reach us via the provided mail and phone number – we'll forward your inquiry internally and get back to you.

on_side.title: On-site in Nuremberg
on_side.content: Our office in Nuremberg is easily accessible by both public transport and car. You'll find detailed step-by-step directions on our directions page.

contact_form.title: Send us a message
contact_form.name: Name
contact_form.subject: Subject
contact_form.agreement: I agree that my data may be used to process my inquiry. Further information can be found in our privacy policy.

error.name: Please enter your name.
error.valid_mail: Please enter a valid email address.
error.consent: Please confirm that you agree to be contacted.
error.general: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.

contact_form.success: Thank you for your message. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

next_steps.title: What happens next?
next_steps.subtitle: We want your inquiry to reach the right people directly. Here's how we typically handle incoming messages.

steps.name: Step 1
steps.title: Receipt & initial review
steps.content: We receive your message and conduct a brief initial review to determine which department or contact person can best handle your inquiry.

steps.name: Step 2
steps.title: Clarification & preparation
steps.content: If needed, we ask for a few additional details to fully understand your requirements and prepare relevant information or options.

steps.name: Step 3
steps.title: Response & next steps
steps.content: You'll receive a personal response with concrete next steps – whether that's a proposal, a suggested appointment, or a direct solution.

why_contact.title: A partner who speaks your language
why_contact.subtitle: From concept to execution – we support your marketing projects with experience, creativity, and reliable project management.

tiles.title: Experience & reliability
tiles.content: Many years of experience in marketing services and project execution – with a strong focus on efficient, reliable processes.

tiles.title: Personal contact
tiles.content: No anonymous ticket system – your inquiry is handled by real people who know your project and stay in touch with you.

tiles.title: Clear next steps
tiles.content: We won't leave you with abstract ideas – we propose concrete next steps, timelines, and implementation options.

CTA.title: We're just a message or a call away.
CTA.content: Use the contact form above, send us an email directly, or give us a call – together we'll find the right way to support your project.
